notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts.
description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Smaug.
When Smaug enters, its first ability triggers, creating a number of tapped Treasure tokens
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the Treasures.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
